brief: Holds a wanted state of a graph, that every instance of a type has an outgoing edge of a given label, and reports who breaks it.
detail: A goal is declarative: RequireEveryHas(type, relation) or FromMeans("every :Type Has(:relation)") sets the pattern, and GapOn(graph) returns the instances that do not meet it. An instance is a node joined to the type's node by an edge labelled isa. The goal never stores a graph, it judges the live one passed in. Time qualifiers such as Within are not evaluated; a sentence without the every and Has clauses is refused with an error.
receiver:
o1 = new stzGraphGoal("priced")
o1.RequireEveryHas("Dish", "Price")
oG = new stzGraph("menu")
oG.AddNode("dish")
oG.AddNode("tajine")
oG.AddNode("couscous")
oG.AddNode("price")
oG.AddEdgeXT("tajine", "dish", "isa")
oG.AddEdgeXT("couscous", "dish", "isa")
oG.AddEdgeXT("tajine", "price", "price")
